descriptionByLocale.it:
Panoramica
Nel team di Microsoft Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE), non si sarà solo costruire un software; si otterrà risultati reali per alcune delle organizzazioni più complesse del mondo.

Siamo un team globale di ingegneri di livello mondiale che hanno lavorato in un modello di Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) per più di un decennio, incorporando direttamente all'interno dei team dei clienti per risolvere le loro sfide più difficili, side-by-side, e la spedizione di soluzioni pronte in giorni, non mesi.

In qualità di Principal Account-Aligned FDE , sarai un ingegnere cliente incorporato per servire come leader tecnico primario allineato a un account strategico, guidando i risultati aziendali attraverso mani su esecuzione e competenze multidisciplinari. In questo ruolo, costruirai e spedirai soluzioni di grado di produzione, lavorerai direttamente con i clienti per tradurre le esigenze aziendali in approcci tecnici chiari e operare con velocità in ambienti complessi e veloci. Si tratta di un ruolo di contributore individuale senior che richiede una forte profondità tecnica, credibilità con gli stakeholder senior, contesto industriale, e un approccio imprenditoriale per navigare ambiguità e fornire un impatto duraturo nel tempo.

La missione di Microsoft è di consentire a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta di ottenere di più. Come dipendenti, ci uniamo con una mentalità di crescita, innovare per potenziare gli altri, e collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sui nostri valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e oltre.

responsabilità

• Guidare i risultati dei clienti plasmando opportunità e traducendo le esigenze aziendali in approcci tecnici chiari e attuabili

• Costruire e fornire soluzioni di qualità produttiva negli ambienti dei clienti, dimostrando una forte esecuzione ingegneristica e la proprietà end-to-end

• Accelerare il tempo al valore operando efficacemente in ambiguità e offrendo soluzioni iterative e ad alto impatto

• Coinvolgere e influenzare gli stakeholder senior per costruire fiducia, allineare le priorità e guidare il processo decisionale tecnico e aziendale

• Applicare il contesto dell'industria e del cliente per personalizzare le soluzioni e passare oltre gli approcci generici

• Lavoro di preparazione e transizione agli equipaggi FDE con una chiara portata e una forte direzione tecnica, mantenendo la continuità nel ciclo di vita di fidanzamento

• Funziona con una mentalità imprenditoriale per navigare dinamiche di account complesse, impostare i confini, e guidare l'urgenza e la responsabilità.

• incarna la nostra cultura e i nostri valori.

Qualifiche
Required/Minimum Qualificazioni

• Corso di laurea E 6+ anni di esperienza in ingegneria, gestione del programma del prodotto / tecnico, analisi dei dati, o sviluppo del prodotto

• O esperienza equivalente

• 3+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti interfunzionali e/o cross-team.

• Prova a collaborare direttamente con clienti o stakeholder interni per offrire soluzioni end-to-end.

Qualificazioni aggiuntive o preferenziali (PQ)

• Corso di laurea E 10+ anni di esperienza in ingegneria, gestione del programma del prodotto / tecnico, analisi dei dati, o sviluppo del prodotto

• O sviluppo del prodotto

• 8+ anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti interfunzionali e/o cross-team.

• 2+ anni di esperienza in ruoli tecnici orientati al cliente (ad esempio, consulenza, ingegneria delle soluzioni, ingegneria del campo o simili).

• Esperienza con tecnologie AI/ML, architettura cloud, ingegneria dei dati, e utilizzando strumenti AI e flussi di lavoro nella creazione di artefatti di ingegneria del software.

• Godetevi il viaggio e sono confortevoli con viaggio fino al 25%

Il nostro team si vanta di abbracciare una mentalità di crescita, ispirando l'eccellenza, e incoraggiando tutti a condividere i loro punti di vista unici ed essere loro stessi autentici. Unisciti a noi e contribuire a creare innovazioni che cambiano la vita che impatto miliardi in tutto il mondo!

In Microsoft, stiamo cercando persone che hanno una passione per la tecnologia di impatto positivo può avere sulle comunità e per fare la differenza nel mondo. Nel nostro team, troverete una vasta gamma di sfondi, prospettive, esperienze personali e culturali che sono vitali per il nostro successo con i nostri clienti. Si tratta di un ambiente di lavoro informale e flessibile e sarete invitati a lavorare nel modo migliore che ti permette di ottenere il vostro lavoro fatto.

Investiamo nella vostra salute, benessere e futuro finanziario offrendo un pacchetto competitivo tra cui una vasta gamma di benefici costruiti intorno alle vostre esigenze personali e quelli vicino a voi.

Overview
In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.

As a Principal Account-Aligned FDE, you will be a customer embedded engineer to serve as the primary technical leader aligned to a strategic account, driving business outcomes through hands on execution and multidisciplinary expertise. In this role, you will build and ship production grade solutions, work directly with customers to translate business needs into clear technical approaches, and operate with speed in complex, fast moving environments. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical depth, credibility with senior stakeholders, industry context, and an entrepreneurial approach to navigating ambiguity and delivering sustained impact over time.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Drive customer outcomes by shaping opportunities and translating business needs into clear, actionable technical approaches

• Build and deliver production-grade solutions in customer environments, demonstrating strong engineering execution and end-to-end ownership

• Accelerate time to value by operating effectively in ambiguity and delivering iterative, high-impact solutions

• Engage and influence senior stakeholders to build trust, align priorities, and guide technical and business decision-making

• Apply industry and customer context to tailor solutions and move beyond generic approaches

• Prepare and transition work to FDE crews with clear scope and strong technical direction, maintaining continuity across the engagement lifecycle

• Operate with an entrepreneurial mindset to navigate complex account dynamics, set boundaries, and drive urgency and accountability.

• Embody our culture and values .

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

• Or equivalent experience

• 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

• Experience partnering directly with customers or internal stakeholders to deliver solutions end-to-end.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications (PQs)

• Bachelor’s Degree AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

• OR product development

• 8+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.

• 2+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles (e.g., consulting, solutions engineering, field engineering, or similar).

• Experience with AI/ML technologies, cloud architecture, data engineering, and using AI tools and workflows in creating software engineering artifacts.

• Enjoy travel and are comfortable with travel up to 25%

Übersicht
Im Team von Microsoft Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE) erstellen Sie nicht nur Software, sondern liefern echte Ergebnisse für einige der komplexesten Unternehmen der Welt.

Wir sind ein globales Team von Weltklasse-Ingenieuren, die seit mehr als einem Jahrzehnt an einem Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)-Modell arbeiten und sich direkt in Kundenteams einbetten, um ihre härtesten Herausforderungen nebeneinander zu lösen und produktionsfähige Lösungen in Tagen und nicht Monaten zu liefern.

Als Principal Account-Aligned FDE sind Sie ein Customer Embedded Engineer, der als primärer technischer Leiter auf ein strategisches Konto ausgerichtet ist und die Geschäftsergebnisse durch praktische Ausführung und multidisziplinäres Fachwissen steuert. In dieser Rolle bauen und liefern Sie Lösungen in Produktionsqualität, arbeiten direkt mit Kunden zusammen, um Geschäftsanforderungen in klare technische Ansätze zu übersetzen, und arbeiten schnell in komplexen, sich schnell bewegenden Umgebungen. Dies ist eine Rolle als leitender Einzelbeitragender, die eine starke technische Tiefe, Glaubwürdigkeit bei leitenden Stakeholdern, den Branchenkontext und einen unternehmerischen Ansatz erfordert, um Mehrdeutigkeiten zu navigieren und im Laufe der Zeit nachhaltige Auswirkungen zu erzielen.

Microsofts Mission ist es, jede Person und jedes Unternehmen auf dem Planeten zu befähigen, mehr zu erreichen. Als Mitarbeiter kommen wir mit einer Wachstumsmentalität zusammen, innovieren, um andere zu stärken, und arbeiten zusammen, um unsere gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Jeden Tag bauen wir auf unseren Werten Respekt, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht auf, um eine Kultur der Inklusion zu schaffen, in der jeder bei der Arbeit und darüber hinaus gedeihen kann.

Zuständigkeiten

• Steigerung der Kundenergebnisse durch Gestaltung von Chancen und Umsetzung von Geschäftsanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare technische Ansätze

• Bauen und liefern Sie produktionsgerechte Lösungen in Kundenumgebungen, die eine starke technische Ausführung und End-to-End-Besitz zeigen

• Beschleunigen Sie die Zeit bis zum Wert, indem Sie effektiv in Mehrdeutigkeit arbeiten und iterative, wirkungsvolle Lösungen liefern

• Engagieren und beeinflussen Sie leitende Stakeholder, um Vertrauen aufzubauen, Prioritäten auszurichten und technische und geschäftliche Entscheidungen zu treffen

• Wenden Sie den Branchen- und Kundenkontext an, um Lösungen anzupassen und über generische Ansätze hinauszugehen

• Vorbereitungs- und Übergangsarbeiten an FDE-Crews mit klarem Umfang und starker technischer Ausrichtung, wobei die Kontinuität während des gesamten Engagement-Lebenszyklus gewahrt bleibt

• Arbeiten Sie mit einer unternehmerischen Denkweise, um komplexe Kontodynamiken zu navigieren, Grenzen zu setzen und Dringlichkeit und Rechenschaftspflicht zu fördern.

• Verkörpern Sie unsere Kultur und Werte.

Qualifikationen
Erforderliche/Mindestqualifikationen

• Bachelor-Abschluss und 6+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Engineering, Produkt- / technisches Programmmanagement, Datenanalyse oder Produktentwicklung

• oder gleichwertige Erfahrung

• 3+ Jahre Erfahrung im Management funktionsübergreifender und/oder teamübergreifender Projekte.

• Erleben Sie eine direkte Partnerschaft mit Kunden oder internen Stakeholdern, um Lösungen durchgängig zu liefern.

Zusätzliche oder bevorzugte Qualifikationen (PQs)

• Bachelor-Abschluss und 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Engineering, Produkt- / technisches Programmmanagement, Datenanalyse oder Produktentwicklung

• ODER Produktentwicklung

• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung im Management funktionsübergreifender und/oder teamübergreifender Projekte.

• 2+ Jahre Erfahrung in kundenorientierten technischen Rollen (z. B. Beratung, Solutions Engineering, Field Engineering oder ähnliches).

• Erfahrung mit AI / ML-Technologien, Cloud-Architektur, Data Engineering und mit KI-Tools und Workflows bei der Erstellung von Software-Engineering-Artefakten.

• Genießen Sie Reisen und sind bequem mit Reisen bis zu 25%

Unser Team ist stolz darauf, eine Wachstumsmentalität anzunehmen, Exzellenz zu inspirieren und alle zu ermutigen, ihre einzigartigen Standpunkte zu teilen und ihr authentisches Selbst zu sein. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie, lebensverändernde Innovationen zu schaffen, die Milliarden auf der ganzen Welt beeinflussen!

Bei Microsoft suchen wir Menschen, die eine Leidenschaft für die positiven Auswirkungen haben, die Technologie auf Gemeinschaften haben kann und einen Unterschied in der Welt macht. In unserem Team finden Sie eine breite Palette von Hintergründen, Perspektiven, persönlichen und kulturellen Erfahrungen, die für unseren Erfolg bei unseren Kunden entscheidend sind. Aperçu général
Dans l'équipe Microsoft Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE), vous n'avez gagné qu'à construire un logiciel ; vous obtiendrez des résultats réels pour certaines des organisations les plus complexes du monde.

Nous sommes une équipe mondiale d'ingénieurs de classe mondiale qui travaillent dans un modèle d'ingénierie avancée déployée (FDE) depuis plus d'une décennie, intégrant directement au sein des équipes clients pour résoudre leurs défis les plus difficiles, côte à côte, et des solutions de production d'expédition prêtes en jours, pas des mois.

En tant que FDE principal de compte-aligné , vous serez un ingénieur intégré client pour servir de leader technique principal aligné sur un compte stratégique, conduisant les résultats d'affaires par des mains sur l'exécution et l'expertise multidisciplinaire. Dans ce rôle, vous allez construire et expédier des solutions de qualité de production, travailler directement avec les clients pour traduire les besoins des entreprises en approches techniques claires, et fonctionner avec rapidité dans des environnements complexes et rapides. Il s'agit d'un rôle de premier plan qui exige une forte profondeur technique, de la crédibilité auprès des principaux intervenants, du contexte de l'industrie et d'une approche entrepreneuriale de la navigation de l'ambiguïté et d'un impact soutenu au fil du temps.

La mission de Microsoft est d'habiliter chaque personne et chaque organisation de la planète à réaliser davantage. En tant qu'employés, nous nous associons à une mentalité de croissance, innovons pour responsabiliser les autres et collaborons à la réalisation de nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d'intégrité et de responsabilité pour créer une culture d'inclusion où chacun peut prospérer au travail et au-delà.

Responsabilités

• Conduire les résultats des clients en formant des opportunités et en traduisant les besoins des entreprises en approches techniques claires et réalisables

Nel team di Microsoft Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE), non si sarà solo costruire un software; si otterrà risultati reali per alcune delle organizzazioni più complesse del mondo.

In qualità di Principal Account-Aligned FDE , sarai un ingegnere cliente incorporato per servire come leader tecnico primario allineato a un account strategico, guidando i risultati aziendali attraverso mani su esecuzione e competenze multidisciplinari. Overview
In the Microsoft Frontier Company Engineering team, you won’t just build software; you’ll deliver real outcomes for some of the world’s most complex organizations.

We are a global team of world-class engineers who have been working in a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model for more than a decade, embedding directly within customer teams to solve their toughest challenges, side-by-side, and shipping production-ready solutions in days, not months.

As a Principal Account-Aligned FDE, you will be a customer embedded engineer to serve as the primary technical leader aligned to a strategic account, driving business outcomes through hands on execution and multidisciplinary expertise. In this role, you will build and ship production grade solutions, work directly with customers to translate business needs into clear technical approaches, and operate with speed in complex, fast moving environments. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical depth, credibility with senior stakeholders, industry context, and an entrepreneurial approach to navigating ambiguity and delivering sustained impact over time.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Drive customer outcomes by shaping opportunities and translating business needs into clear, actionable technical approaches

• Build and deliver production-grade solutions in customer environments, demonstrating strong engineering execution and end-to-end ownership

• Accelerate time to value by operating effectively in ambiguity and delivering iterative, high-impact solutions

• Engage and influence senior stakeholders to build trust, align priorities, and guide technical and business decision-making

• Apply industry and customer context to tailor solutions and move beyond generic approaches

• Prepare and transition work to FDE crews with clear scope and strong technical direction, maintaining continuity across the engagement lifecycle

• Embody our culture and values .

You will initiate warranty claims and process returns on failed equipment. This opportunity will allow you to build working knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction, and advance your career in the process.
Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Logistics Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
Responsibilities

• Perform assigned tasks and escalate issues during high-volume work activity or escalation-based situations under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues.

• Coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices. This includes information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.

• Develop working knowledge of stock control and inventory management practices and procedures.

• Ensure accurate documentation of incoming and outgoing deliveries as well as records.

• Become familiar with guidelines set by Microsoft contractual agreements with suppliers and maintain a strong customer focus.

• Perform cycle audits and data corrections to ensure all inventory controls are met.

• Help to reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.

• Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.

• Under the supervision of more experienced Data Center colleagues, destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies.

• Comply with all security and data management policies.

• Embody our culture and values .

• High School Diploma AND 6 months experience or an internship in inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field

• Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Overview
Be part of a culture that celebrates excellence and drives innovation where success is a shared journey.
As a Commercial Skilling Manager within The Global Skilling (GS) team, you will join a group dedicated to shaping the future of technical skills enablement and measurable business impact worldwide. The Global Skilling team is learner obsessed, building an enthusiastic learning culture and driving strategic initiatives that accelerate Microsoft’s growth as a Cloud and AI leader. In this role, you will develop and execute skilling plans empowering the global workforce and reaching new learners—especially those in emerging roles and evolving industries—ensuring they are equipped to thrive in the AI era.
You will collaborate with sales teams and internal stakeholders to ensure skilling and enablement are key differentiators in customer adoption of Microsoft platforms. Your expertise will be critical to helping customers accelerate digital transformation, achieve their business outcomes, and succeed on their AI journey. Join us to guide customers and partners, enabling them to build the essential technical skills that drive business results.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with Customers: Work closely with customers to analyze their skilling needs and create comprehensive skilling plans focused on AI and Microsoft technologies. Align skilling solutions with strategic business goals to accelerate adoption and transformation.

• Customer Relationship Building: Cultivate relationships with customers throughout their AI journey. Engage with C-suite and stakeholders to demonstrate the value of skilling and translate business requirements into actionable strategies.

• Pipeline Management: Maintain a robust pipeline of skilling opportunities to support our business. Regularly forecast and track skilling engagements , ensuring they are aligned with the strategic priorities of field sales teams and customer needs. Proactively communicate status and adjust plans to meet demand.

• Orchestrate Resources for Execution: Execute skilling plans by orchestrating resources across digital platforms, training partners, and Microsoft trainers . Ensure excellence in execution by driving consistency, quality, and impact across delivery motions.

• Strategic Insights and Thought Leadership: Provide thought leadership on developing technical capabilities within our customer base. Your vision should emphasize scalable and high-impact skilling approaches .

• Effective Communication: Bridge technical and business audiences. Clearly articulate the value of AI skilling and adapt communication styles to resonate across diverse stakeholder groups.

• Innovation and Opportunity Development: Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and market demands. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to pilot novel learning initiatives that enhance AI adoption and drive organizational growth.

Qualifications

• Master's Degree or equivalent AND/
• OR several years experience in Learning and Development, relevant technical roles, business development, quota management, human resources (HR), customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, or program/project management

• OR Vocational qualification or higher education degree (e.g., Bachelor's Degree) AND/

• OR several years experience in Learning and Development, relevant technical roles, business development, field or sales, HR, customer success, collection management, research/restoration evaluation, industry, or program/project management

• OR equivalent experience.

• Fluency in both German and English required
Additional or Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with Microsoft offerings (products and cloud and AI services), processes, and tools preferred along with prior experience in crafting or delivering training across diverse technical domains.

• Experience in driving large-scale enablement programs , with a track record of meeting or exceeding skilling targets and business impact metrics.

• Demonstrated thought leadership in learning & development , such as developing new training content, implementing innovative learning tools, or contributing to industry forums on skilling.

• Proven ability to collaborate with stakeholders, both externally and internally. Demonstrated experience engaging with customer executives and cross-functional internal teams to drive initiatives forward.

• Communication skills , with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business benefits. Presentation, writing, and interpersonal skills are a needed as well.

• High adaptability and problem-solving ability , including navigating change, ambiguity and adjusting plans to meet evolving needs. Self-driven and effective in a remote/virtual team environment.

• A growth mindset with a passion for continuous learning, and a collaborative approach that aligns with Microsoft’s values of respect, integrity, and accountability.

You use deep industry experience to lead a dedicated team across the full transformation engagement lifecycle, helping customers achieve measurable business outcomes in a trillion-dollar addressable market. Responsibilities The CDP is first and foremost a relationship leader. You build trusted, long-term relationships with customer executives and help them shape business strategy and execute against it. You are a recognized expert with a strong track record delivering complex programs and turning executive decisions into results. Your core responsibilities include developing executive relationships with customers in a matrixed environment by bringing relevant industry insights and solutions that enable customer success in the marketplace. You work to deliver the transformation solutions in a matrix environment that strengthens trust in Microsoft through consistent, high-quality execution. Working with delivery and technical solutioning teams aligned to the account, you build a culture focused on business outcomes and product realization. L'Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE) team è un'organizzazione di ingegneria globale che lavora fianco a fianco con i clienti, su base progetto, per innovare soluzioni personalizzate per risolvere i loro problemi aziendali complessi; dalla concezione alla produzione. Sviluppiamo modelli di soluzione applicabili a livello generale e di impatto elevato e attività software aperte in collaborazione con i team di prodotti Microsoft, i partner e le comunità open-source. Stiamo assumendo un Data Scientist per costruire e distribuire sistemi AI a livello di scala come parte di un team interfunzionale — lavorando su progetti che spagnano la visione computerizzata, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, i sistemi di raccomandazione, l'analisi predittiva e l'AI generativa. Analizzerai i dati complessi, progetterai esperimenti per validare le ipotesi e stabilirai metriche che collegano gli esiti tecnici all'impatto aziendale. Lavorando accanto agli ingegneri e ai responsabili dei programmi tecnici, architterai soluzioni AI end-to-end, svilupperai pipeline di ML pronte per la produzione e contribuirai a un'infrastruttura scalabile che serve milioni di utenti mentre implementi le pratiche MLOps a livello di scala aziendale. Il titolo del lavoro dice 'Data Scientist', ma se ti consideri un 'Ingegnere AI/ML' questo è ancora per te! La missione di Microsoft è quella di dare potere a ogni persona e ogni organizzazione del pianeta per raggiungere di più. Il nostro team si vanta di accogliere un mindset di crescita, di innovare per dare potere agli altri e di collaborare per realizzare i nostri obiettivi condivisi. Ogni giorno costruiamo sulle nostre valori di rispetto, integrità e responsabilità per creare una cultura di inclusione dove tutti possono prosperare al lavoro e al di là. ## Responsabilità - Guida i progetti o i team di data-science per allinearsi alle esigenze aziendali e consegnare valore. - Guida gli sforzi di acquisizione e comprensione dei dati per i progetti di ingegneria utilizzando varie strumenti e tecniche. - Sviluppa e applica le framework di ML e le migliori pratiche per soluzioni scalabili e etiche. - Sovrasta la revisione delle tecniche di analisi dei dati e dei modelli. Assicura che le tecniche di modellazione selezionate siano adatte e allineate con gli esiti desiderati del progetto. Decide sulle prossime mosse (ad esempio, la distribuzione, ulteriori iterazioni, nuovi progetti). - Fornisce feedback, guida l'innovazione e condivide conoscenze come esperto di data science. - Scrive e debugga codice per progetti complessi e guida lo sviluppo della soluzione. - Guida le partnership e l'IP miglioramento di ML e data-science. - Fornisce informazioni e soluzioni orientate ai clienti comprendendo l'azienda, il prodotto, i dati e la prospettiva del cliente. - Incarna la nostra cultura e i nostri valori. ## 
• Requisiti - Laurea magistrale o laurea in Data Science, Matematica, Statistica, Econometria, Economia, Ricerca operativa, Informatica o campo correlato e esperienza in data-science (ad esempio, gestione di dati strutturati e non strutturati, applicazione di tecniche statistiche e presentazione dei risultati) e 3-5 anni di esperienza lavorativa. - Ti piace viaggiare e sei a tuo agio con viaggi fino al 25%. - Esperienza di consegna di progetti faccia a faccia con i clienti. - Esperienza di lavoro come parte di team geograficamente dispersi, diversi e virtuali. ##

All'interno di ISE, troverai una vasta gamma di background, prospettive, esperienze personali e culturali che sono vitali per il nostro successo con i nostri clienti. È un ambiente di lavoro informale e flessibile e sarai benvenuto a lavorare in modo che meglio ti consenta di fare il tuo lavoro. - Investiamo nel tuo benessere, nella tua salute e nel tuo futuro finanziario offrendoti un pacchetto competitivo che include una vasta gamma di benefici costruiti intorno alle tue esigenze personali e a quelle delle persone a te care. ## Contatto - Data Science IC4 - Il range di base di paghe per questo ruolo in Svizzera è di CHF 146.200,00 - CHF 219.400,00 all'anno.
